title: Bounded finite free models from constant finite free residue cohomology
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l with its valuation ring and uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and an affine scheme S [def-pc-scheme] categorically weakly contractible for its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let K be a derived-complete complex [def-weil-derived-complete] over the inverse limit of the constant finite quotient coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Assume its residue has finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude] and every residue cohomology sheaf is isomorphic to a finite power of the residue unit. Then there are integers a<=b and a cochain complex P with zero terms outside [a,b], every term isomorphic to a finite power of the completed regular module, and an isomorphism K to Q(P) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There is no covering or locally constant trivialization conclusion.

proof.text: Finite powers of the unit are projective by [lem-sf-weakly-contractible-unit-projective]. Transport projectivity along the finite-free cohomology isomorphisms of a representative of the residue, and apply [lem-sf-projective-homology-zero-differential-model]. This constructs an actual zero-differential residue representative and an isomorphism in the derived category. Test the recorded Tor predicate against the regular module in degree zero, using a K-flat resolution. The ordinary complex right unitor, followed by the augmentation quasi-isomorphism, identifies this tensor with the original residue. Thus its cohomology vanishes outside [a,b]. The cycle-lifting model has these cohomology objects as its actual terms, so the termwise finite-free isomorphisms and both explicit bounds follow.

Write the chosen Tor interval as [a,a+d] where d=toNat(b-a), using the ordering in the Tor-amplitude definition. Induct on d. Apply [lem-sf-complete-residue-top-cell] to the split residue model: its first object has a single-degree finite-free model; its third object is zero when d=0, or has a bounded zero-differential finite-free residue model at d-1. Its zero differentials identify its cohomology with its terms, giving the finite-free cohomology hypothesis for induction. Finite powers of the unit are flat, by finite-product closure of flat objects. Thus the supplied bounded model has monoidal Tor amplitude by the bounded-flat-model lemma, and the K-flat tensor comparison transports this to the recorded resolution-tested Tor predicate. This proves the smaller Tor interval required by induction, for all test sheaves and all K-flat resolution choices.

The zero object has the zero-complex model, whose terms are the empty power of the unit. For the induction step use [lem-sf-bounded-projective-models-extensions] and the model of the smaller cone. Finite-free term classes are invariant under isomorphism and closed under biproducts: concatenate the two finite index sets using finSumFinEquiv and the universal property of products. Their terms are projective by [lem-sf-weakly-contractible-unit-projective]. Transport the resulting middle-object model through its isomorphism with K. Finally replace the lower bound c by min(c,e) to order the bounds without changing the complex.

theorem complete_constant_residue_free_model
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (hweak : (Scheme.ProEt.topology S).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 S)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E S))
    (hcomplete : IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S K)
    (hTor : HasFiniteProEtaleTorAmplitude S
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
      ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K))
    (hfree : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ N : ℕ, Nonempty
      (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules S (proEtaleConstantRing S
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))) q).obj
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K)) ≅
        ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin N ↦ SheafOfModules.unit (integralCoefficientSheaf.{u, u} l E S 0))) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E S) ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
      a ≤ b ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ r : ℤ, ∃ N : ℕ, Nonempty
        (P.X r ≅ ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin N ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
          (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S))) ∧
      Nonempty (K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
